A_trait: floral volatile profile / emission richness and diversity
decision_note: Primary Solidago study measures floral VOC phenotype, herbivory, pollination-success proxy and seed production. Herbivory is an upstream observed context rather than a receiver response to the floral VOC coordinate, so retain as near-pass only.

A_trait: individual flowering rank and flowering synchrony
decision_note: Primary Vaccinium study follows flowering phenology across four subpopulations and two years and relates the same phenology coordinate to pollinator limitation, flower/seed predation and fruit production.

A_trait: multiple floral traits and floral-antagonist damage states across dissertation experiments
decision_note: Dissertation contains multiple primary experiments on floral mutualists, floral antagonists and reproduction. Record-level geometry remains composite and requires chapter/axis decomposition before H1 use.

A_trait: flower number; nectar volume; light-mediated floral phenotype
decision_note: Primary Odontonema study resolves light effects on floral traits, nectar robbery and reproductive output, but the current source audit does not recover a direct pollinator response to the same floral coordinate; retain as near-pass.
